To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of principal component analysis to deal with missing data in multivariate analysis is a very good idea.
the principal component method of handling missing values in discriminant analysis is generally superior to other methods considered.
the mean substitution method is the best method for handling missing values in discriminant analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the treatment of missing data in the context of linear discriminant analysis.
the treatment of missing values in discriminant analysis.
the problem of classification of objects according to the group to which they belong when some of the measurements are missing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mean substitution method is best for small samples of 10 to 20 observations per group.
, in the absence of a specific hypothesis, the best procedure is to use all available data with no replacement, and to use all variables, including those containing missing values.
there is no simple, generally valid method of dealing with missing values.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the principal component method, when applied to a complete sample of observations from a population, is a very good approximation to a method which uses all the observations in a sample with no replacement.

, for a given set of missing values, the mean substitution method is superior to the principal component method and that, in the absence of a priori knowledge of the distribution of missing values, a method that uses the mean substitution technique is superior to the other techniques considered.
, for the cases considered, mean substitution and principal components are the best methods of handling missing data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
missing values should be handled in a way that is appropriate for the problem at hand.
, in the case of missing values, the mean substitution method is the best method.
, when missing data is present, it is important to consider the missing data pattern and the missing data mechanism.
